behavioral_evals.scenario: When user mentions 'deploy' or 'database' or 'port' or 'mirror', the skill loads the 4 L3 environment blocks
expected_behavior: Agent checks ~/.config/opencode/AGENTS.md for the matching block (Personal Rules / Architecture Principles / Port Exposure Rules / Mirror Sources) via Read/Grep
Agent aligns the task with the loaded hard rules (e.g. no local DB process, port 12121 restrictions, official-source-first mirror policy)
Agent does NOT modify the user-level AGENTS.md — read-only load
Agent answers in Chinese per Personal Rules block

behavioral_evals.scenario: User asks to start a static preview server on a local machine
expected_behavior: Agent checks port 12121 rules: ls the --directory contents to confirm no sensitive files
Agent runs pgrep -fa 12121 to check for leftover processes before starting
Agent refuses to expose sensitive paths (backend/build/, .env*, ~/.ssh/, etc.) on the public port
Agent uses the template command with mem constraints where cloud resources are involved

behavioral_evals.scenario: User asks to install a dependency or pull code from GitHub
expected_behavior: Agent defaults to official sources (github.com, npm registry, pypi.org, docker.io)
Agent only switches to a mirror after official timeout, using explicit per-command URLs (no global git insteadOf rewrites)
Agent verifies tool presence with which <tool> before installing
